124348.overview: Snorlax’s Lunch Time is an unused Pokémon Party Mini mini game that could be found amongst the other mini games in Pokémon Channel for the Nintendo GameCube.

418017.overview: The game is played on a 5x5 grid full of lights that can be either lit or unlit. The objective of the game is to turn off all the lit lights in as few moves as possible. Lights are changed by clicking on them but all adjacent buttons are then also changed. Making a change creates an effect pattern.
